import sys, os
sys.path = [p for p in sys.path if p]
import functools, http.server as hs
_orig_end_headers = hs.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler.end_headers
def _end_headers(self):
    self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
    _orig_end_headers(self)
hs.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler.end_headers = _end_headers
preview_dir = os.path.join(os.environ.get('TMPDIR', '/tmp'), 'boxscorethedraft-preview')
hs.ThreadingHTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', 8934), functools.partial(hs.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, directory=preview_dir)).serve_forever()
